updates.title: No more teleporting on objects
updates.text: Objects no longer throw the player around. Ledge grabbing now works only on real flat ledges, not on circles, triangles, tilted or spinning shapes. Climbing a ledge is a smooth climb instead of an instant jump onto the top, and you no longer bounce up right after climbing. Jumping at a block that is too high no longer sends you back to spawn.

updates.title: No bouncing off objects
updates.text: Objects no longer push the player back or sideways on their own. Walking into a steep slope or a wall just stops you instead of throwing you back, standing on a slope no longer slides you off, and the edge of a shape touching your head no longer makes you shake. Only objects with Ricochet turned on bounce the player.

updates.title: Stability improvements
updates.text: Internal fixes and automated checks so the game stays stable after every update.

updates.title: Faster movement
updates.text: The player now runs and jumps 1.2 times faster. Jump height and distance stay the same, so every map plays as before, just quicker.

updates.title: Clearer dark theme
updates.text: The dark theme is now a plain dark grey look with white text, and selected buttons are white so you can always see what is picked. Light pills and white lines on the Leaderboard, pink-tinted buttons and hard to read text in Settings and on the Avatar page are fixed.

updates.title: Clearer layer buttons in the editor
updates.text: The Order buttons in the map editor are now called Send to back and Bring to front, show a short tip on hover and explain under them what they do: which object is drawn on top where objects overlap, and which platform moves you when two overlap.
